summary: Retest of the iteration_12 ad fixes on the Expo web preview at 375x667, using free user ania_t1. All 4 fixes and the regression PASS. FIX 1: a fake 3rd path was seeded in MongoDB. On the new career 2f0fe194c355 there is no choose-ad-notice. Tapping 'Wybieram tę ścieżkę' shows choose-error 'Masz już 3 ścieżki. Usuń jedną w zakładce Droga, aby dodać nową.' and choose-manage-paths, with no ad-modal and no POST /api/roadmap. A 2nd tap also shows no ad, and 'Zarządzaj ścieżkami' opens /road. FIX 2: on the existing path 'Analityk finansowy' (2551fdb521cb) there is no notice and no ad. The tap goes straight to the celebration, then /road with road-career-title 'Analityk finansowy'. Verified with 2 paths and again at the 3-path limit. FIX 3: POST /roadmap was mocked to avoid an LLM call. ad-modal text was sampled every 30 ms for about 450 ms after 'Kontynuuj': it always kept the rewarded copy and never showed 'Reklamy pomagają utrzymać…'. The celebration and /road followed. FIX 4: tested with Playwright clock plus simulated document visibility. 6 min spent on the auth screen before login gave no interstitial at 45 s or 75 s after login. 6 min hidden (background) plus 30 s active gave no ad. About 5.5 min of active time gave the interstitial ('Możesz zamknąć za 5 s'). Code review agrees: lastAdAt resets when showAds becomes true, and the AppState background delta is added back. Regression (2 paths, new career): choose-ad-notice and choose-go-premium are visible. The tap opens ad-modal with 'Nagroda za 5 s' and no Kontynuuj during the countdown. No POST /roadmap is sent before the ad finishes, and 'Wyłącz reklamy z Premium' cancels (0 POSTs) and opens /premium. No deprecated Expo packages in the reviewed files.

issues: The inline link 'Bez reklam z Premium.' (testID choose-go-premium) is about 128x15 px, well below the 44 px touch target. Add hitSlop/padding or make it a separate small button.

action_items: Optional (minor): enlarge the touch target of the choose-go-premium inline link (currently 15 px tall).

Optional (minor): SimulatedAd sets `view` in useEffect, so the first frame of a newly opened ad can still show the previous ad's kind/reason, e.g. a rewarded ad opened right after an interstitial. Use `const shown = sim ?? view` when rendering to remove the 1-frame flicker. Not observed in testing.

Optional (minor): in choose(), if the /paths query has not loaded yet (paths.data undefined), a user at the limit still gets the ad and then a 403. Consider awaiting/refetching paths, or disabling the button until paths.isSuccess.
critical_code_review_comments: AdsProvider: resetting lastAdAt in the showAds effect correctly starts the 5-min timer at login. The AppState delta (background to active) correctly excludes background time. The interval also skips when not active.

career/[id].tsx: the limit and existing-path checks run before watchAd, and the notice is hidden when alreadyMine/atLimit/limitHit. Existing match is by career title, which is the same approach as the backend 'existing' detection.

Re-choosing 'Analityk finansowy' made it active during the test; the original active path (ERP fba2ceb59234) was restored in MongoDB. ania_t1 is back to 2 paths, free (not premium). No LLM generations were triggered: POST /roadmap for the new career was mocked with Playwright route.

Career 2f0fe194c355 is new and its detail is already cached, so no LLM call on open. 2551fdb521cb is an existing path. Mock POST **/api/roadmap with page.route to test the ad flow without LLM cost. Interstitial: page.clock.install() before goto, then fast_forward. Simulate background by overriding document.visibilityState and dispatching visibilitychange.
